body:
New, real, separate matchmaking mode alongside the existing 8-player FFA sandbox queue: a genuine duel (real MODE_STOCK), exactly 2 combatants, a bot fills the second slot after a real 5s timeout if no second human queues. Wire format carries the requested mode in PACKET_FIND_MATCH's own NetHeader.entity_count, defaulting to FFA for full backward compatibility. New server-side mm_queue_1v1/mm_start_match_1v1, new client N key + mode-aware waiting screen. Live-verified end to end against the real deployed brawlpit-server.service: solo-queueing 1v1 gets a real PACKET_MATCH_FOUND + genuinely 2-entity snapshot at 5s; FFA path re-verified unaffected. 25/25 physics tests pass.

⚓ ☃
title: BPMM-1202020: real 1v1 matchmaking with a bot pool shipped
